concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish tap, fibrous and adventitious root systems with their origin and examples.
Identify the regions of a root tip and the function of each.

topics.title: The stem and the structure of a leaf

concepts.learning_objective: State the origin, features and functions of the stem that distinguish it from the root.
Describe the leaf base, petiole and lamina and the role of each.

topics.title: Venation, types of leaves and phyllotaxy

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish reticulate and parallel venation and relate them to dicots and monocots.
Distinguish simple, pinnately compound and palmately compound leaves.
Identify alternate, opposite and whorled phyllotaxy with examples.

topics.title: Inflorescence and the general features of a flower

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish racemose and cymose inflorescences by growth of the axis and order of flowers.
Classify flowers by symmetry and by the number of floral appendages.
Classify flowers as hypogynous, perigynous or epigynous from the position of the ovary.
Identify valvate, twisted, imbricate and vexillary aestivation with examples.
Describe the stamen and the cohesion and adhesion of stamens.
Describe the carpel, apocarpous and syncarpous ovaries and the types of placentation.
Describe the pericarp of a fruit, drupes and parthenocarpic fruits.
Describe the structure of a dicotyledonous seed and endospermic and non-endospermous seeds.
Describe the structure of a monocotyledonous seed such as maize.

topics.title: Semi-technical description and the family Solanaceae

concepts.learning_objective: Read and interpret the symbols of a floral formula and a floral diagram.
Recognise the vegetative and floral characters and economic importance of Solanaceae.
